name: Twin Homing Laser
doc: Twin Homing Laser (enemy attack 283, Mobile Type 8's): the GF cinematic engine's clone run from the two script files (mag252_b.00 / .01, its parameters) - its bones, prims, sprites and particles, the action results. The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag253_twin_homing_laser.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).
